signals.signal: AWARDED 21/08/2026: Banka Slovenije awarded 'Preventivno in korektivno vzdrzevanje sortirnih sistemov' (preventive + corrective maintenance of banknote-sorting systems) to GIESECKE+DEVRIENT CURRENCY TECHNOLOGY GmbH (Prinzregentenstrasse 159, Munich) for EUR 1,890,000.00 excl. VAT. Only 1 bid, received 13/08/2026; opened 17/08/2026. Notice JN005737/2026-EUe16/01 = TED 495378-2026, ref JN-76928. Scope: BPS M7 MEvo-12SBN plus standby BPS M7 MEvo-10LSBN, both with Nota Tracc + LVM modules, through 31/08/2032 (6 years). Award value is ~96% above the EUR 963,000 previously reported for the prior contract.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil (e-narocanje) - Sklep o oddaji javnega narocila, JN005737/2026-ODL/01 (PDF)
signals.implies: Category 1 (cash automation) and 11 (managed/field services): the Slovenian central bank's banknote-processing estate is locked to G+D to 2032. Printec's Glory/Sesami/Consillion lines and field-service business cannot enter BS sorter maintenance in this cycle.
signals.likelihood: Contract signature imminent; 8-working-day review window from 21/08/2026
signals.followup: Monitor eRevizija for a revision claim before ~02/09/2026; probe BS cash-centre adjacencies (counting/packaging, coin) instead.

signals.signal: CANCELLED 03/07/2026: the FIRST attempt at the same sorter-maintenance contract - JN003263/2026-EUe16/01 (TED 287173-2026, internal ref 2.09.3.1.02-7/2026, published 27/04/2026) - ended with a 'Sklep o neoddaji narocila' (decision not to award). The single bid, from Giesecke+Devrient Currency Technology GmbH, was excluded as inadmissible after the 22/06/2026 deadline. Four corrigenda (P01-P04) had already moved dates. Re-tendered two weeks later as JN005737/2026.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - Sklep o neoddaji narocila, JN003263/2026-ODL/01 (PDF)
signals.implies: Evidence of a single-vendor market: two consecutive open procedures drew exactly one bidder. Any Printec entry would need G+D-certified BPS M7 technicians (the award criteria demand 3-4 manufacturer-certified techs with 5+ years on BPS M7).
signals.followup: None; use the M2 criteria (certified-technician counts) as a template for arguing multivendor service capability elsewhere.

signals.signal: [STANDING - dated 2025] Banka Slovenije awarded 'Nadgradnja obstojece programske opreme na dveh sortirnih sistemih BPS M7' (software upgrade to M EVO on two BPS M7 sorters, removal of a two-stacker module, repositioning of BPS M7-14 and replacement of the cutting module on BPS M7-10) to Giesecke & Devrient GmbH for EUR 350,500 (estimate EUR 356,557.37), single bid, contract 2.09.3.1.02-16/2024-11 signed 11/02/2025. JN006991/2024-EUe29/01 = TED 110277-2025.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - JN006991/2024-EUe29/01 (contract award notice)
signals.implies: Confirms a continuous G+D relationship (hardware, software, now 6-year service) - the incumbency Printec would have to displace to sell cash-processing into the Slovenian central bank.
signals.followup: None.

signals.signal: AWARDED 30/04/2026: Banka Slovenije contracted 'Procesiranje in poravnava SEPA cezmejnih kreditnih placil' (processing and settlement of SEPA cross-border credit transfers) to BANKART procesiranje placilnih instrumentov d.o.o., Ljubljana (reg. 1244272000) at EUR 100,000 (estimate EUR 100,000), single bid. Notice JN001586/2026-SL2/01, ref JN-70332, contract 2.09.3.1.01-3/2026 signed 30/04/2026, published 07/05/2026. Below-EU-threshold small-value procedure, no TED notice.
signals.implies: Category 4 (payments modernization): Bankart is the national payments processor and the gatekeeper for Slovenian instant-payments/ISO 20022 work - a partner-or-competitor for Printec rather than a direct tender opening.
signals.followup: Profile Bankart (owned by the Slovenian banks) as the route to Slovenian instant-payments and card-processing modernisation.

signals.signal: AWARDED 27/02/2026: Banka Slovenije awarded upgrades, maintenance and operational technical support for SISBON (the national retail credit-register information system) to ADACTA programska oprema d.o.o., Ljubljana (reg. 8339414000) at EUR 479,850 (estimate EUR 479,360), single bid, contract 2.09.3.1.02-16/2025. JN009309/2025-EUe29/01 = TED 165850-2026, published 10/03/2026.
signals.implies: Category 12/7 (core & digital channels, compliance): Adacta holds the credit-bureau platform at the central bank - the incumbent to know for any Slovenian AML/KYC or credit-data adjacency Printec pitches (IMTF Siron, FICO).
signals.followup: Track the SISBON contract end-date for the next re-tender.

signals.entity: Uprava RS za javna placila (UJP - Public Payments Administration)
signals.signal: AWARDED 30/12/2025 (published 21/01/2026): UJP awarded card-acquiring for the UJP online-payments system ('Zagotavljanje opravljanja placil s placilnimi karticami za uporabnike sistema spletnih placil UJP', ref JN 3/2025 - UJP e-placila, TED 45458-2026) to BANKA INTESA SANPAOLO d.d., Koper (reg. 5092221000) across 4 of 6 lots: Mastercard EUR 859,950; Visa EUR 460,350; Activa EUR 1,620; BA/Maestro EUR 810 - total EUR 1,322,730 against a EUR 1,031,285 estimate. 2 bids per lot, 1 admissible. Lots 5 (Karanta) and 6 (other cards) not awarded. Contract C1618-25Y701002.
signals.implies: Category 3 (POS/acquiring): Banka Intesa Sanpaolo is the acquiring incumbent for the whole Slovenian public sector's online card payments. A direct acquiring competitor and a reference point for Printec's terminal-management/softPOS positioning.
signals.followup: Establish the UJP contract term and the next re-tender date; check whether terminal supply is bundled or separate.

signals.entity: Ministrstvo za notranje zadeve (Ministry of the Interior)
signals.signal: AWARDED 21/05/2026 (published 25/06/2026): MNZ awarded card-payment acceptance over PORTABLE POS TERMINALS - supply of up to 100 terminals plus servicing/replacement - to NOVA LJUBLJANSKA BANKA d.d. (NLB, reg. 5860571000) at EUR 213,114.75 (estimate identical), single bid. Ref 430-1653/2025, notice JN000626/2026-EUe29/01 = TED 433160-2026, contract C1714-26-460077. A parallel smaller MNZ procedure JN001232/2026-EUe16/01 (TED 126354-2026, ref 40-12/2026, 14 portable POS terminals, est. EUR 52,423.86) closed 23/03/2026 - no award notice published on the portal as at 27/08/2026.
signals.implies: Category 3 (POS terminals + terminal management): Slovenian public-sector POS is bought as a BANK SERVICE, not as hardware. NLB and Banka Intesa are the buyers of terminals; Printec's route to market is via those banks/Bankart, not via the state.
signals.likelihood: Running; the 14-terminal lot award still unpublished
signals.followup: Chase the award on JN001232/2026 (14 terminals); confirm which terminal brand NLB deploys under C1714-26-460077.

signals.entity: Javni zavod Lekarna Ljubljana (Ljubljana public pharmacy institute)
signals.signal: AWARDED 18/06/2026 (published 23/06/2026): 'Storitve prejema pologov gotovine' - reception of daily cash takings from the pharmacies, 3 years - awarded to NOVA LJUBLJANSKA BANKA d.d. (reg. 5860571000) at EUR 102,028.50 against a EUR 197,000 estimate, single bid. Ref NMV 5/2026, notice JN004067/2026-SL2/01, contract 697-64/2026. Two corrigenda (P01, P02) preceded it. This CLOSES OUT the baseline 'unconfirmed' Lekarna Ljubljana item.
signals.implies: Category 1 (cash automation): retail cash deposits in Slovenia are bought as a bank cash-handling service. The natural Printec play is selling recyclers/TCRs to NLB so it can automate this deposit flow, not bidding for the service itself.
signals.followup: Use as a proof point in an NLB retail-cash-automation pitch (Glory/Sesami TCR).

signals.signal: AWARDED 10/04/2026 (published 22/04/2026): Posta Slovenije's cash-in-transit framework 'Prevzem, predaja in prevoz gotovine ter drugih vrednostnih posiljk z oborozenim spremstvom' (collection, handover and transport of cash and other valuables with armed escort, 2 years) went to SINTAL d.o.o., Ljubljana (reg. 5446252000) for Lot 1 (PLC Ljubljana area) at EUR 70,000; Lot 2 (PLC Maribor, est. EUR 5,000) was NOT awarded. Single bid per lot. Ref JN-68111, notice JN000209/2026-SL4/01, framework 6600002804/JNS. Total estimate EUR 75,000.
signals.implies: Category 1 adjacency (cash-in-transit): Sintal and Aktiva Varovanje split the Slovenian CIT/security market. Relevant to Printec's CIT adjacency and to any Posta Slovenije cash-automation pitch.
signals.followup: Watch for a re-run of the unawarded PLC Maribor lot.

signals.signal: [STANDING - dated 2025] Posta Slovenije awarded 'Vzdrzevanje in servisiranje varnostnih kovckov za prenos gotovine' (maintenance and servicing of intelligent banknote neutralisation cases - IBNS - used to carry cash) to AKTIVA VAROVANJE d.d. (reg. 5263565000), framework 6600002588, EUR 110,000 estimate, single bid, signed 02/10/2025 (ref 0017/2025/0017/JNS/6, notice JN007176/2025-EUe30/01). Preceded by a voluntary ex-ante transparency notice JN007176/2025-EUe26/01 of 12/09/2025.
signals.implies: Category 8 (physical ATM/cash security, IBNS): the only Slovenian IBNS service contract found; Aktiva Varovanje is the incumbent servicer.
signals.followup: Identify the IBNS case brand Posta uses; a supply/refresh tender is the entry point.

signals.entity: Okrozno sodisce v Mariboru (Maribor District Court)
signals.signal: AWARDED 31/07/2026 (result published 19/08/2026): physical, technical and intervention guarding PLUS cash collection and transport for the Maribor District Court and its local courts, awarded WITHOUT prior publication (negotiated procedure, Art. 46(1)(c) ZJN-3) to a joint bid of AKTIVA VAROVANJE d.d. (reg. 5263565000) and PROTECT INFRA varnostni inzeniring d.o.o. (reg. 5806283000) at EUR 255,134.50 against a EUR 321,927.19 estimate. Contract C4219-26-000036, ref Su 498/2026. Voluntary ex-ante transparency notice TED 532578-2026 (31/07/2026); result notice TED 572285-2026 (19/08/2026).
signals.implies: Confirms AKTIVA VAROVANJE d.d. as an active Slovenian cash-logistics/guarding winner - the baseline's unconfirmed 'Banka Slovenije cash logistics / AKTIVA VAROVANJE' lead is at least partly resolved: Aktiva is a live cash-transport contractor to the Slovenian state.
signals.followup: Map Aktiva Varovanje's and Sintal's bank clients as CIT partners for Printec's cash-cycle offer.

signals.signal: AWARDED 23/01/2026 (published 27/01/2026): FURS's 'PDS - pologi denarnih sredstev' (bank-account cash deposits FURS makes into various sub-accounts, ref JN 40/2025, notice JN009161/2025-SL2/01) went to POSTA SLOVENIJE d.o.o. (reg. 5881447000) at EUR 52,245.79 against a EUR 116,101.75 estimate, single bid, contract C1620-26-000004. FURS also bought banknote-counting and counterfeit-detection devices twice in 2025 (JN 19/2025 and JN 25/2025 BAN); the JN 25/2025 lot went to PIGO d.o.o., Ljubljana (reg. 5823790000) for EUR 7,560, contract C1620-25-000056 of 22/05/2025.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - JN009161/2025-SL2/01 and JN002961/2025-SL2/01
signals.implies: Category 1: FURS's cash-handling equipment spend is tiny (EUR 7.5k desktop counters via a local reseller, PIGO d.o.o.) and its cash logistics run through Posta Slovenije. No meaningful Printec opportunity at FURS; PIGO is the low-end counter reseller to beat.
signals.followup: Watch for the 2026 'BAN' repeat; a Glory/Sesami desktop counter could contest it.

signals.signal: AWARDED 22/06/2026 (published 26/06/2026): 'Vzdrzevanje varnostnih sistemov zaklepanja...' - maintenance, replacement and upgrade of Assa Abloy / Abloy security locking systems, keys and locks across the post-office estate - awarded to SOFRAN d.o.o. (reg. 2186462000) at EUR 385,707.22, single bid, framework 6600002892, ref JN-72799, notice JN003083/2026-SL4/01. Separately Posta awarded ZIMI accessibility works on post offices (for blind/deaf/mobility-impaired customers) to TaktilPro d.o.o. (reg. 9692711000) at EUR 433,370 (framework 6600002611, 06/10/2025, JN006105/2025-SL4/01).
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - JN003083/2026-SL4/01 and JN006105/2025-SL4/01
signals.implies: Categories 7 (accessibility compliance) and 8 (physical security): Posta Slovenije is actively spending on branch physical security and on European Accessibility Act-style branch accessibility - the same drivers behind Printec's accessible-kiosk and branch-transformation offer.
signals.followup: Position accessible self-service kiosks for the next Posta counter-automation cycle; Printec S.I. d.o.o. already has the parcel-locker relationship.

signals.entity: Ministrstvo za notranje zadeve / Upravne enote (Ministry of the Interior + all 58 administrative units)
signals.signal: AWARDED 24/11/2025, EXTENDED 08/05/2026: MNZ signed framework C1711-25-462023 with CETIS d.d., Celje (reg. 5042208000) for design, production, storage, PERSONALISATION, dispatch and destruction of Slovenian travel documents with biometric data plus other official documents - EUR 41,901,521.90 against a EUR 40,193,333.69 estimate, SINGLE BID. Ref 430-904/2024, notice JN005194/2025-EUe29/01 = TED 805943-2025. A modification notice of 08/05/2026 (JN005194/2025-EUe29/01-P01 = TED 316420-2026) added all 58 upravne enote and the Foreign Ministry as buyers. Drawdowns already visible in the national contracts register include EUR 27,128,749 (20/05/2026) and EUR 1.68m/1.21m tranches.
signals.implies: Category 10 (card issuing & personalisation) + 5 (digital identity): CETIS is the Slovenian national personalisation incumbent - the local equivalent of Veridos in Cyprus - and won unopposed. Any Printec card-personalisation or eID play in Slovenia goes through or against CETIS.
signals.followup: Establish the framework end-date; assess CETIS as a partner for Printec card-issuing/personalisation in the wider region rather than a target to displace.

signals.entity: Ministrstvo za digitalno preobrazbo (Ministry of Digital Transformation)
signals.signal: TWO digital-identity/key-security awards: (1) [STANDING - dated 2025] 'Nabava in vzdrzevanje streznikov HSM' - purchase and maintenance of HSMs (hardware security modules: the tamper-proof boxes that hold cryptographic keys) - awarded to OSI sistemske resitve d.o.o. (reg. 3329615000) for EUR 303,685.36 against a EUR 341,706.64 estimate, single bid, contract C3150-25-304401-Osi of 26/08/2025 (JN004471/2025-EUe29/01 = TED 568377-2025). (2) NEW 10/02/2026: 'Najem mobilnih enot za zbiranje biometricnih podatkov za potrebe upravnih enot' (rental of mobile biometric-enrolment units for administrative units) awarded to CENT SI d.o.o. (reg. 3343839000) at EUR 386,280, 2 bids, contract C3150-25-139811 (JN008811/2025-EUe29/01 = TED 138314-2026).
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - JN004471/2025-EUe29/01 and JN008811/2025-EUe29/01
signals.implies: Categories 9 (HSM/key management - Printec sells Thales payShield) and 5 (digital identity/eKYC enrolment). Slovenia buys HSMs and biometric enrolment through small local integrators (OSI, CENT SI) - candidate channel partners rather than head-on competitors. This is the ONLY HSM procurement found on the portal.
signals.likelihood: HSM contract running; biometric rental to 2026-2028
signals.followup: Approach OSI sistemske resitve and CENT SI as reseller channels for Thales payShield / EUDI-wallet enrolment ahead of the next refresh.

signals.entity: Posta Slovenije d.o.o. / PRINTEC S.I. d.o.o.
signals.signal: PRINTEC INCUMBENCY VERIFIED with figures: Posta Slovenije awarded 'Nakup paketomatov za siritev mreze v letu 2025 z vzdrzevanjem za obdobje petih let' (purchase of parcel lockers for 2025 network expansion, with 5-year maintenance) to PRINTEC S.I. informacijska tehnologija, d.o.o. (reg. 5952590000) at EUR 3,594,900, SINGLE BID, framework 6600002501 signed 14/08/2025. Ref 0011/2025/0011/JNB/6; voluntary ex-ante transparency notice TED 438620-2025 (07/07/2025), award notice JN005242/2025-EUe30/01 = TED 624355-2025 (24/09/2025). NO follow-on parcel-locker tender has been published for 2026 as at 27/08/2026 (searched 'paketomat', 'paketnik', 'paketni avtomat' on the portal back to 2023).
signals.implies: Printec's Slovenian beachhead is worth EUR 3.6m + 5-year service and was won unopposed via a negotiated procedure - strong evidence Posta treats Printec S.I. as the sole capable supplier. The natural next step is widening that relationship into branch self-service/counter automation and cash handling.
signals.followup: Ask Posta Slovenije directly about a 2026/2027 parcel-locker expansion round and about counter-automation; watch for another EUe26 ex-ante notice.

signals.entity: Ministrstvo za notranje zadeve (Ministry of the Interior)
signals.signal: AWARDED 17/04/2026: MNZ decision 430-12/2026/23 awarded the 14-terminal portable-POS procedure (JN001232/2026-EUe16/01 = TED 126354-2026) to NOVA LJUBLJANSKA BANKA d.d. - EUR 7,870.46 incl. VAT for the 4-year rental of 14 POS terminal sets plus an estimated EUR 52,423.86 of commissions over 4 years, with an option to increase by up to 30%. Single bid received by 23/03/2026. Card-transaction services are VAT-exempt under Art. 44(4) ZDDV-1.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - Odlocitev v zvezi z oddajo narocila, JN001232/2026-ODL/01 (PDF)
signals.implies: Category 3: closes the gap left in the earlier MNZ signal. NLB now holds both MNZ POS contracts (100 terminals + 14 terminals). Terminal rental is priced at a few hundred euro per unit per 4 years - the money is in the acquiring commission, which is where Printec's TMS/softPOS value has to be argued.
signals.followup: Identify which terminal make NLB supplies under both MNZ contracts.

signals.entity: Slovenian public pharmacies and UJP (card acceptance)
signals.signal: A cluster of 2026 card-acceptance/banking-services awards shows who acquires for the Slovenian public sector: Obalne lekarne Koper awarded 3 lots (IP POS terminals + banking services) to BANKA INTESA SANPAOLO d.d. totalling EUR 82,860 on 30/01/2026 (JN009577/2025-SL2/01, est. EUR 130,000); Javni zavod Kraske lekarne Ilirska Bistrica awarded banking services to Banka Intesa at EUR 139,365 (16/06/2026, JN003426/2026-SL2/01); Javni lekarniski zavod Dolenjske lekarne and Lekarna Ljubljana to NLB; Mariborske lekarne to OTP banka d.d. (EUR 40,040, 20/11/2025). UJP's earlier POS-rental contract JN008973/2024-SL2/01 went to NLB at EUR 99,075.80 (19/02/2025, 2 bids).
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - JN009577/2025-SL2/01 and the national contracts register (pogodba CSV, 2026 Q1-Q3)
signals.implies: Category 3: Slovenian public-sector card acceptance is a three-horse race - NLB, Banka Intesa Sanpaolo and OTP banka. They are Printec's actual customers for terminals, TMS and softPOS; the state itself never buys terminals as hardware.
signals.followup: Build a terminal-estate profile for NLB, Banka Intesa SI and OTP banka SI; these three are the addressable POS market in Slovenia.

signals.signal: AWARDED 05/05/2026: Okrozno sodisce v Novem mestu awarded physical/technical guarding PLUS cash collection and transport for the Novo mesto, Crnomelj and Trebnje courts and the Ljubljana Labour & Social Court to GVS d.o.o. - globalno varnostni servis (reg. 1534238000) at EUR 746,292.81 against a EUR 765,102.59 estimate, single bid, contract C4222-26-000007 (JN000551/2026-EUe29/01 = TED 310235-2026). Other 2026 court cash-transport winners: VAROVANJE GALEKOM d.o.o. (Nova Gorica EUR 48,857.94; Kranj EUR 29,979.44), SINTAL d.o.o. (Univerza na Primorskem), FIT d.d. (Lekarna Ljubljana guarding, EUR 260,616.58).
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - JN000551/2026-EUe29/01 plus the national contracts register
signals.implies: Cash-in-transit adjacency: the Slovenian CIT/guarding field is Sintal, Aktiva Varovanje, GVS, Varovanje Galekom, FIT and Valina. None of them supplies cash-automation hardware - each is a potential channel for Printec counters/recyclers/IBNS.
signals.followup: Shortlist Sintal, Aktiva Varovanje and GVS as CIT partners for a Slovenian cash-cycle offer.

signals.signal: TWO OPEN Banka Slovenije tenders as at 27/08/2026: (1) 'Vzdrzevanje in nadgrajevanje sistema Kadris, pristopne kontrole in registracije delovnega casa' - maintenance and upgrade of the KADRIS 4 HR system plus ACCESS CONTROL and time-registration for all Banka Slovenije buildings, JN006451/2026-EUe16/01 = TED 562809-2026, ref JN-78027, published 13/08/2026, bids due 17/09/2026 10:00, no published estimate. (2) 'Podaljsanje licenc in vzdrzevanje sistema za upravljanje varnostnih dogodkov (SIEM)' - SIEM licence renewal and maintenance, JN006388/2026-EUe16/01 = TED 555367-2026, ref JN-77945, published 11/08/2026, bids due 21/09/2026 10:00, no published estimate.
signals.implies: Categories 8 (physical security/access control) and 7 (operational resilience, DORA). Both are incumbent-renewal shaped and neither is core Printec, but the access-control lot is the closest live Banka Slovenije opening to Printec's physical-security line.
signals.followup: Decide by 10/09/2026 whether to bid the access-control element; otherwise track the winners.

signals.signal: OPEN: 'Dobava uporabniske opreme za obdobje treh let' (supply of user equipment for 3 years, 4 lots - computers, monitors, printers, other IT equipment), JN006554/2026-EUe17/01 = TED 569790-2026, ref JN-78132, published 18/08/2026, requests to participate due 17/09/2026 12:00, questions by 04/09/2026, no published estimate. Also open: 'Komunikacijska oprema 2026' (NGFW firewall replacement, DWDM licence upgrade, Wi-Fi access points at PLC Maribor and PLC Ljubljana), JN005236/2026-EUe17/01 = TED 451218-2026, published 01/07/2026. Separately Posta's parcel-sorter contract with EAE Solutions B.V. (Oosterhout, NL) is registered at EUR 8,262,492 (11/06/2026, JN006156/2025).
signals.implies: Not core Printec (no counter/self-service or cash lot), but it confirms Posta Slovenije is in an active multi-year equipment-refresh cycle - the window in which to raise branch self-service kiosks and cash automation alongside the existing parcel-locker relationship.
signals.followup: Use the refresh cycle as the pretext for a Printec S.I. account conversation on counter automation.

signals.entity: SID banka (Slovenska izvozna in razvojna banka d.d.) - state export/development bank
signals.signal: NEWLY IDENTIFIED BUYER: SID banka is a state-owned BANK that IS a contracting authority and publishes on e-narocanje - 60 notices since 06/2025. 2026 awards: 'Vzpostavitev, implementacija in vzdrzevanje resitve DAM (IBM Guardium)' - database activity monitoring - to SMARTIS d.o.o. (reg. 3637735000) at EUR 79,500 against a EUR 120,000 estimate, 2 bids, contract JN-0198/2026 of 15/07/2026 (JN002577/2026-EUe29/01 = TED 492314-2026); and 'Vzdrzevanje in nadgradnje informacijskega dokumentnega sistema BusinessConnect' (4 years) to AVTENTA d.o.o. (reg. 5925975000) at EUR 597,938 against a EUR 600,000 estimate, single bid, 19/08/2026 (JN004389/2026-EUe29/01 = TED 579869-2026).
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - JN002577/2026-EUe29/01 and JN004389/2026-EUe29/01
signals.implies: Categories 6/7/12: the ONE Slovenian commercial-style bank whose IT spend is publicly tendered. It has no branch network or ATMs, so no cash opportunity, but it is a live, visible buyer for monitoring, document management and (potentially) AML/fraud tooling - and a rare window into Slovenian bank IT pricing.
signals.likelihood: Rolling procurement, several notices per quarter
signals.followup: Add SID banka to the watch list and screen its notices monthly for AML/fraud/transaction-monitoring and e-signature scope.

signals.signal: AWARDED 14/05/2026: FURS 'JN 15/2026 - vzpostavitev sistema registracije delovnega casa in kontrole dostopa' (time-registration and access-control system) to CETRTA POT informatika d.o.o. (reg. 5337976000) at EUR 698,444.88 incl. VAT, CPV 35123300 (JN003250/2026-EUe29/01, preceded by ex-ante notice JN003250/2026-EUe25/01 of 27/04/2026). FURS also awarded 'JN 5/2026 KLJUCAR' electronic key-safe cabinets (result 26/05/2026, JN001416/2026-EUe29/01) - a repeat of the 2025 'JN 9/2025 KLJUCAR' buy.

signals.signal: STRUCTURAL FINDING (negative, evidenced): ZERO ATM tenders exist on e-narocanje. A CPV sweep on 30123200 ('avtomatski stroji za izdajo bankovcev' = automatic banknote-dispensing machines) plus 30123600/30132000/30132200/30132300/35121200 back to 06/2025 returned no ATM, recycler or self-service notice from any Slovenian buyer, and title wildcards '%bankomat%' and '%samopostrezn%' returned 0 and 2 hits (both railway ticket machines) back to 01/2025. Reason: NLB, Banka Intesa Sanpaolo, OTP banka, SKB/OTP, Delavska hranilnica, Gorenjska banka and Addiko are private and are NOT contracting authorities under ZJN-3, and Bankart (the shared processor) does not publish. The only banking-sector contracting authorities in Slovenia are Banka Slovenije, SID banka and - as a utility-sector buyer - Posta Slovenije.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih narocil - CPV and title searches via the site JSON API (obrazec/objava/obrazecGetGrid)
signals.implies: Categories 1, 2 and 8: the Slovenian ATM/self-service market is NOT reachable through procurement intelligence. Printec must sell it directly to NLB, Banka Intesa SI, OTP SI and Bankart. Absence of notices is a disclosure fact, not evidence of no demand.
signals.followup: Route Slovenian ATM/recycler pipeline through direct bank contact and through the Geldservice Austria EUR 9.1m recycler framework, which delivers into Slovenia.

coverage_notes: Portal: e-narocanje.si / Portal javnih narocil (Slovenia). Route that worked: the Vue SPA 404s to non-browser clients, but its public JSON API does not - POST https://www.enarocanje.si/api/obrazec/objava/obrazecGetGrid with a desktop Chrome User-Agent (filters: narocnikNaziv, naslov with SQL-style % wildcards, sklopNaslov, narociloNaslov, idSifCpv + podrejeniCpv, objavaDejanskaDatumOd, prejem), then GET /api/obrazec/objava/obrazecGet?id=<idObrazec> for full detail (lots, bid counts, winners with registration numbers, contract numbers and signature dates), GET /api/obrazec/objava/dosjeObrazecGetList?idDosje=<n> to enumerate every form in a dossier (including ODL decision forms), and GET /api/datoteka/get?id=<b64> for the decision PDFs (read locally with pdfminer). Also downloaded the national contracts register CSV at /api/pogodba/pogodbaCsvGet?obdobje=<0-4>&leto=<year> - 21,081 contracts for 2026 Q1-Q3 - and mined it for CPV 3012*/3013*/3016*/3521*/66110*/66150* and cash/card/POS/biometric keywords. Angles used (>=3 per lead): (1) buyer-name sweeps - Banka Slovenije (54 notices in 2026), Posta Slovenije (121), Ministrstvo za finance/FURS/UJP (64), SID banka, SDH, Kapitalska druzba, Bankart; (2) CPV sweeps on 30123200 ATMs, 30123600/610/620/630 coin machines, 30132000/200/300 sorting + banknote counters, 35121200 counterfeit detection, 30142000 registers, 30160000-30163000 cards, 30233300/320 smart-card and fingerprint readers, 35125110 biometric sensors, 22430000/22450000 banknotes and security documents, 42963000 coin presses, 66110/66150/66172 banking and payment-processing services; (3) Slovenian-language title/lot wildcards - bankomat, bankovcev, gotovine, sortirnih, samopostrezn, POS termin, placiln, kartic, stetje, trezor, kioski, identitet, podpis, biometr, HSM, kljucev, paketomat, recikl, digitaliz; (4) the contracts register cross-check; (5) the pre-refreshed TED cache (only 3 SVN notices in the 13/07-27/08/2026 window, none cash/ATM/POS - all three are cross-checked here or irrelevant). PRODUCT-CATEGORY GAPS THIS RUN (nothing found on this portal): (1) ATM & cash automation/recycling - ZERO notices, evidenced by CPV 30123200 returning nil back to 06/2025 (reported as a structural signal); (2) self-service kiosks & branch transformation - nothing; (3) POS/acquiring - present only as BANK SERVICES (NLB, Banka Intesa, OTP), never as terminal hardware; (4) payments modernization - only the Banka Slovenije/Bankart SEPA cross-border processing contract, no instant-payments, ISO 20022, RTGS or digital-euro tender; (6) fraud & transaction monitoring - nothing; (10) card issuing & personalisation - only the CETIS travel-document framework, no bank card personalisation; (12) core & digital channels - only SISBON and SID banka document management. Categories WITH findings: 1 (cash logistics/counting, small), 5 (biometric enrolment, HSM), 7 (accessibility, document management, DORA-adjacent SIEM), 8 (physical security, IBNS, locking, access control), 9 (HSM, KMS), 11 (Printec S.I. parcel-locker maintenance). Baseline carry-over statused: Banka Slovenije sorter maintenance 17/08/2026 = AWARDED to G+D at EUR 1,890,000 excl. VAT on 21/08/2026 (top item, resolved); Javni zavod Lekarna Ljubljana = AWARDED to NLB 18/06/2026 (resolved); Banka Slovenije cash logistics / AKTIVA VAROVANJE = Aktiva confirmed as a live Slovenian cash-transport contractor (Maribor District Court, 31/07/2026) but NOT as a Banka Slovenije contractor - no Banka Slovenije cash-logistics notice exists on the portal; FURS / Posta Slovenije = both resolved (FURS cash deposits run through Posta Slovenije, EUR 52,245.79, 23/01/2026). Not in scope for this portal and not attempted: Hrvatska posta 26.2.83, the Hungarian Act XVIII coverage verdict, the Croatian shared-ATM-network law.
access_issues: enarocanje.si /pregled-objav/<id> returns HTTP 404 to non-browser clients (Vue SPA, client-side routing) - confirmed with a desktop Chrome User-Agent, so the UA retry alone does NOT fix it. Resolved by reading the SPA bundle https://www.enarocanje.si/assets/index-eeafb3e1.js and its lazy chunks (Objava-59e3c1a8.js, Pogodba-c7d2003d.js, Evidencna*.js) to recover the API contract, then calling https://www.enarocanje.si/api/ directly with a desktop Chrome UA - all endpoints returned 200 without authentication. Bare /api/ and guessed paths (/api/pregledobjav) return 404; only the exact endpoint names work. The naslov filter is a prefix match unless you wrap the term in % wildcards - an early sweep without wildcards produced false negatives and was redone. Decision PDFs at /api/datoteka/get?id=<base64> download fine and were text-extracted locally with pdfminer. The evidencna-narocila endpoints (evidencnaNarocila/vnos/*) are behind a login and were NOT used; the public evidencna data is only an annual aggregate report (2025 period closed 07/03/2026), so below-threshold award detail was taken from the contracts register CSV instead. No CAPTCHA was encountered or attempted; no login wall was worked around. No source was dropped.
